column1: # Outlet domain -> newsroom home, rebuilt from public sources (e53 condition 2).
# Independent of the curated table in tools/outlet_home_table.py: two research
# passes were given ONLY the list of 120 domain strings -- never the curated
# answers -- and told to resolve each against Wikipedia, the Library of
# Congress newspaper catalogue, archive.org snapshots of the outlet's own
# contact page, FCC/station records and media directories, and to return
# UNKNOWN rather than guess. Every row carries the URL it came from.
# place = city of publication, a region when the outlet is explicitly regional,
# or NONE for an outlet with no home market (wire services, national
# broadcasters). A row with a place gets a point-level home; NONE gets a
# country-level home. That differs from the curated table's convention, under
# which a national newspaper with a real head office (Haaretz, the Irish
# Independent) was given only its country -- the researchers found the city and
# it is recorded here, which is one of the disagreements the report quantifies.
